notes.title: Acolyte Voice Within Update Available Now!
notes.content:
The first major update to our natural-language narrative ARG is AVAILABLE NOW, alongside our first sale for the game, with [b]25% off [/b]for a full week. 

The [b]Acolyte Voice Within Update[/b] brings some key new functionality to the game, including:

[list][*] Full, dynamic AI voice-over 
[*] New 'Daily Horoscope' module 
[*] New facts added
[*] New jokes added 
[*] 100s of lines of new dialogue
[*] Improved Hint system 
[*] Performance Improvements 
[*] Additional fixes & polish [/list]

The TTS (Text to Speech) feature is the real star of the show here, melding with the game's Natural Language Input to offer dynamic voice-over, bringing your Acolyte to life through spoken word. Here, we've partnered with [url=https://www.readspeaker.com/]ReadSpeaker[/url] to give Ana her voice, which not only benefits the narrative of the game, but also introduces an important layer of accessibility that was missing before now. 

Check out the brand new trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=rYT1R5N8QNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks, and until next time.

Jamin & The Superstring Team

[h3]Play Acolyte today![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1516330/Acolyte/

notes.title: Acolyte v1.0.1 Update Now Live
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39563146/81fef1e0777b9766a23944d87943d0d721da5349.png[/img]

First things first: [b]HUGE [/b]thanks to those of you that have picked up Acolyte and chucked yourself down the rabbit-hole of ARG sleuthing. I've been watching as many streams and videos of the game as I can, and seeing how different players tackle the game via its open-ended input is fascinating. 

To the small subset of players that have managed to solve all the game's puzzles: [b]kudos.[/b] The game game has - and I quote the NME review here - "some of the hardest video game puzzles you’ll ever solve" - so to welcome some of you to the elusive Club100 so soon has been a pleasant surprise. 

There will be a bigger update with more substantial feature additions in due course, but I wanted to get a first patch out the door as soon after launch as possible to address a few of the smaller issues that have been cropping up. 

In this first update to the game, we've added: 

[list]
[*] Expanded valid-inputs for certain puzzle solutions
[*] Revised hints for certain puzzles 
[*] Improved scene flow for moving between LOI (Lines of Investigation)
[*] A fix for the 'Crossing the Ts and Dotting the Is' Achievement not popping for some players 
[*] New additional valid responses for the 'GET TO KNOW YOUR ACOLYTE' task. 
[*] A bunch of very boring but very needed typo-fixes
[/list]

And that's it for this very minor first patch. 

Huge thanks once again to everybody that has checked out the game. 

Jamin & The Superstring Team

[h3]Play Acolyte today![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1516330/Acolyte/
